view: AP portable (supine/semi-erect) frontal chest radiograph, paediatric (F, 11 y); L marker and up-arrow at image upper-right confirm conventional orientation (patient's left on image right)
technical_quality: Adequate but limited: portable AP with the detector/patient tilted a few degrees (image rotated counter-clockwise) and mild rotation; adequate inspiration and penetration (spine visible through the mediastinum); apices, both costophrenic angles, humeri and upper abdomen included. Numerous overlying external lines, coiled tubing and an ECG electrode degrade assessment of the left mid zone and both lateral chest walls.

zone_sources.bbox: upper (box 218x562 px spans most of the right hemithorax; localisation artefact of a tall box)
zone_sources.adjudicator: lower (dense component; layering fluid veils the whole right hemithorax up to the middle zone)

devices.type: Probable central venous catheter (right internal jugular approach)
devices.location: Enters at the right side of the neck, courses over the right clavicle and descends along the right paramediastinal region; tip projects over the lower SVC / cavoatrial junction (about T6-T7)
devices.zh: 疑似右內頸靜脈中心靜脈導管，尖端位於下段上腔靜脈／腔房交界處

devices.location: Overlying the left mid zone lateral to the left hilum (anterior 3rd-4th rib level); lead wire runs up to coiled tubing over the left clavicle
devices.zh: 心電圖電極片（左中肺野）

devices.type: External coiled tubing / lead wires (double loop)
devices.location: Left upper hemithorax overlying the left clavicle and first ribs
devices.zh: 體外盤繞管線（左上胸／左鎖骨區）

devices.location: Right shoulder / right axilla / right upper arm, continuing down along the right lateral chest wall
devices.zh: 體外盤繞管線（右肩、右腋及右上臂）

devices.location: Right supraclavicular region just above the medial right clavicle
devices.zh: 體外管線接頭（右鎖骨上區）

devices.location: Right mid zone lateral to the right heart border / near the right hilum, about the 5th-6th posterior rib level
devices.zh: 體外管線接頭（右中肺野近右肺門）

devices.location: Running along both lateral chest walls; the right-sided lines cross the right lung field to the mid-chest connector, two left-sided lines end with radiopaque terminals over the left flank / left upper abdomen
devices.zh: 多條體外監測導線／管路（兩側胸壁，左側兩條末端接頭投影於左側腹）

devices.type: Radiographic side marker (L) with upright arrow

other_findings: 右側積液下方可能合併右下葉肺塌陷或實變（右心緣與右橫膈均被遮蔽，單張影像無法與積液區分）
整個右側胸廓透明度較左側減低（仰臥位層狀積液），並向右中肺野延伸
左下肺野及心後區輕微斑片狀模糊影，可能為肺塌陷；左肋膈角清晰
兩肺支氣管血管紋理輕度增加
心縱膈影顯得寬大，惟受 AP 放大、旋轉及右側積液遮蔽影響無法準確評估
氣管居中，未見明顯縱膈偏移；未見氣胸
左側橫膈與胃泡可見；骨骼未見骨折，肱骨頭生長板可見（符合兒童年齡）
未見氣管內管或鼻胃管
suitability_reason: 右側大量肋膜積液清楚可見，且未見胸管、肋膜引流管或引流後變化；但片上有疑似右內頸靜脈中心靜脈導管、心電圖電極片及大量體外監測導線與管路，顯示病人已在住院／加護照護中接受治療，與「首次就診、尚未接受任何處置」的情境不符。較適合作為住院或加護病房追蹤影像使用。
description_zh: 攜帶式 AP 正面胸部 X 光（11 歲女童），影像略呈逆時針傾斜且病人輕度旋轉，吸氣尚可；體表覆蓋多條監測導線與盤繞管路，左中胸壁見心電圖電極片，右鎖骨上及右中肺野各見一個體外管線接頭，右頸部另見疑似右內頸靜脈中心靜脈導管，尖端投影於下段上腔靜脈／腔房交界處。右側中下肺野呈大片均質緻密影，外側緣向上弧形上升，右側橫膈、右肋膈角及右心緣均被遮蔽，且整個右側胸廓透明度較左側減低，符合仰臥位大量右側肋膜積液（緻密影上下範圍約 10-12 公分）並向右中肺野延伸，其下方不排除合併右下葉塌陷或實變。左肺大致通氣良好，肺紋理略增加，左下肺野及心後區有輕微斑片狀模糊影，左肋膈角清晰，左側橫膈與胃泡可見。心縱膈影顯得寬大，惟受 AP 放大、旋轉及右側積液遮蔽影響難以準確評估；氣管居中，未見明顯縱膈偏移，未見氣胸、胸管或肋膜引流管，亦未見氣管內管；骨骼未見骨折，肱骨頭生長板可見。
